then.summary: Experienced food vendors apply on the supervisory food-vendor track: 2,200 licenses per year through 2031.

records.citation: Intro 1251 / Local Law of 2026; Admin Code Title 17 TODO(law: §)

then.summary: Merchandise (general) vendors: roughly 10,500 new licenses start in 2027. The old cap was 853 (set 1979) and the waitlist has been closed since 2016.

records.citation: Intro 431-B (enacted, veto overridden late Jan 2026); build master §20.2 verified facts 2026-08-14

then.summary: Since March 9, 2026, vending violations are civil. A civil summons goes to an OATH administrative hearing; the worst outcome is a fine.

A criminal summons requires a court appearance and is a different instrument from a civil OATH summons. Criminal summonses have continued in practice after decriminalization. Sidewalk explains the difference and refers to a legal clinic; it never gives advice on a criminal matter.

records.citation: Local Law 122 of 2025 eff. 2026-03-09; Q1 2026 practice: 564 criminal summonses (verified 2026-08-14)

then.summary: For licensed vendors, discipline runs through suspension or revocation of the license — an administrative process with hearings and records — rather than cart confiscation.

records.citation: Intro 431-B (enacted package, Dec 2025, veto overridden late Jan 2026)
